comment: Held-out research questions (RESEARCH-HELDOUT-01). Written 2026-11-01 BEFORE any outcome of the coverage change was read, across twelve kinds of subject, so a change that only helps one question shows up. The pass criteria are fixed here: the opening must carry two of the identifiers and a judge must confirm it is about the exact subject, every topic must be covered (any listed phrase), the answer must span the minimum number of distinct sites, and no person, place or title may appear that no passage, note, query or the question gives. Never edit a case after reading a run; add a case instead and say so.
